summary: Full backend + frontend e2e testing of Patch & Pot (regional gardening app). 12/12 backend pytest cases pass including AI guidance with food+flower 'kind' badges, guidance caching, and Gemini image generation+cache. Frontend: Home hero, RegionPicker localStorage flow, Calendar guidance sections + food/flower badges, Plants grid (32 items, 12 flowers filter, search), Plant detail Add-to-Garden, My Garden CRUD, Pests page, Guides index (5 cards), /guides/cut-flowers (2 PDFs, 3 palettes, 26 table rows) and /guides/companion (Great combos, Mini guilds, container pairings) all verified working. No critical bugs found.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py is approaching ~490 lines and contains both PLANTS dataset and route logic — consider splitting plants data into a separate module (e.g. backend/data/plants.py) for better maintainability.

Both Home.jsx (Set your region button) and Header.jsx (region-picker-trigger button) instantiate independent RegionPicker modals; the modals are mounted in parallel but stay collapsed (open=false). It works but consider a single top-level provider/context to avoid duplicated RegionPicker JSX across pages (also in MyGarden.jsx).

useMyGarden + useRegion hooks read localStorage in a useState initializer (good), but they don't listen to the 'storage' event so state set programmatically (e.g. devtools/multi-tab) won't re-render — minor, not user-facing.

The /api/plant-image endpoint uses LLM key check inside the route AFTER cache check — fine, but no rate-limiting; expensive Gemini calls could be abused if endpoint exposed without auth (project explicitly chose no-auth, so acceptable).
Companion guide uses curly quote in 'Mini ‘guilds’ by goal' — purely stylistic, content is correct.
seed_data_creation: None — PLANTS dataset is hard-coded in server.py. Guidance + image responses cached in Mongo (db.guidance_cache, db.image_cache) on first call.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Backend regression suite is at /app/backend/tests/test_backend.py — 12 tests including AI guidance (Claude Sonnet 4.5) and image gen (Gemini Nano Banana). On first run Gemini image takes ~10-20s; subsequent calls are cached and <500ms. All localStorage keys: 'patchpot.region.v1', 'patchpot.garden.v1', 'patchpot.tasks.v1'. data-testid coverage is excellent throughout. Region picker is mounted three times (Home, Header, MyGarden) — they share useRegion hook so behaviour is consistent.
